title: "Final Project"

::: {.callout-note}
Full instructions and the grading rubric will be released in **Week 10
(November 11)**. This page summarizes the shape of the project so you can plan
ahead.
:::

Each student produces a comprehensive statistical analysis of a public-health
dataset, modeled on the Week 10 case study.

## Deliverables (due 11:59 PM, Wednesday December 16)

1. **A GitHub repository** containing all code and a reproducible **Quarto
   report** with sections on introduction, data preparation, exploratory data
   analysis (tables, plots, results, interpretations), and summary. The report
   must render from your repository as submitted.
2. **A 5-minute recorded video walkthrough** of your analysis: what question
   you asked, what you found, and a tour of your key figures.
3. **An AI-use appendix**: what you asked AI tools, what they produced, and
   what you verified or changed.
